title: PBMC Isolation from Apheresis Collars with SepMate Tubes
author: Girija Goyal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qpcdviw
materials: Dilute 100x by adding 10ul cell solutions to 890 ul media/buffer and 100ul of Trypan blue undetermined, Cell solution undetermined, Media/buffer undetermined, Trypan blue

steps.title: Collect Blood from Apheresis Collar
steps.instruction: Extract blood from the apheresis collar into a 50mL conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Cut the cone from the collar and place it on a 50mL conical tube.
Cut the top end to release the blood and allow it to drip into the tube.

steps.title: Dilute Collected Blood
steps.instruction: Dilute the collected blood with an equal volume of RPMI or PBS and mix well.

steps.title: Perform Density Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Perform density centrifugation using a 50ml SepMate tube (STEMCELL Technologies Inc. Catalog #85450) and Lymphoprep™ 250 mL (STEMCELL Technologies Inc. Catalog #7801) following the manufacturer's directions.

steps.title: Harvest White Cell Layer
steps.instruction: Collect the white layer of cells located just above the plastic insert into a final volume of 20 ml of media or buffer, limiting the amount of Lymphoprep harvested, and mix well.

steps.title: Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 300 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate the media and resuspend the cells in 20 mL of warm media/buffer, depending on subsequent steps.

steps.title: Count Cells
steps.instruction: Count the cells using a hemocytometer by counting the number of cells in each of the four quadrants.

substeps.instruction: Calculate total cells using the formula: Cells/ml = cells counted * dilution factor * 10^4 cells / 4

steps.title: Store Cells
steps.instruction: Keep cells in solution in the refrigerator for up to two hours.
